subjects.title: System Design
subjects.description: Design large-scale systems: from latency and caching to consensus, streaming and full case studies.

lessons.title: Authenticated encryption through a library
lessons.summary: AEAD encrypts data and authenticates it together with optional public associated data.

lessons.title: Digests and three different security goals

lessons.title: Trusted digests, Merkle paths and unambiguous inputs

lessons.title: What message authentication proves

lessons.summary: HMAC applies different inner and outer key-derived prefixes to defeat classic length extension.

lessons.title: Verify exact bytes without a timing shortcut
lessons.summary: Use the library’s content-independent comparison on validated fixed-type tags.

lessons.title: Webhooks, shared verifier keys and AEAD tags
lessons.summary: Every holder of an HMAC verification secret can also mint valid tags.

lessons.title: Why encryption and authentication order matters
lessons.summary: Under suitable assumptions, encrypt-then-MAC checks protected ciphertext before decryption.

lessons.title: Public keys, trapdoors and factoring
lessons.summary: Authenticate the recipient’s public key before encrypting to it.

lessons.title: Build and protect a toy RSA key

lessons.title: Trace RSA encryption and why it decrypts
lessons.summary: RSA exponentiation recovers every valid message representative under the generated key.

lessons.title: Determinism and malleability in textbook RSA

lessons.title: RSA-OAEP, message limits and hybrid encryption
lessons.summary: RSA-OAEP randomises message encoding and has a strict maximum input length.

lessons.title: Understand points on a finite-field curve
lessons.summary: A finite-field elliptic curve is a group of discrete points with a specified addition rule.

lessons.title: Scalar multiplication and the discrete-log gap
lessons.summary: A public ECC point is a private scalar multiple of a specified generator.

lessons.title: Quantum risk and public-key implementation failures

lessons.title: Generate secrets with the operating system
lessons.summary: Use a CSPRNG for unpredictable keys and tokens, with nonce requirements specific to the scheme.

lessons.title: Extract and expand keys with HKDF

lessons.title: Salts, offline guessing and memory cost

lessons.summary: A pepper protects a stolen database only while its separate secret remains unavailable.

lessons.title: Certificate trust chains and fields
